title: Build a triangle of hashes
description: Write a function `build_triangle(rows)` that returns a multi-line string: row `i` (1-indexed) contains `i` `#` characters.
hints: Idea to consider: build one line per row, then join them
'#' * i repeats the character i times - for row i that's exactly the line you need, no character-by-character loop required.
Build a list of '#' * i for i from 1 to rows, then join the lines with '\n'.
expected_behavior: Returns rows lines, line i (1-indexed) holding i '#' characters.
solution:
def build_triangle(rows):
    return "\n".join("#" * i for i in range(1, rows + 1))
explanation: String repetition ('#' * i) replaces an inner loop that would otherwise print one '#' at a time - the outer loop only needs to vary i.
